name: Clermont Partners
description: Chicago-based ESG, investor relations, and transaction communications consultancy acquired by Riveron in June 2022. The acquisition sources describe corporate advisory services; they do not substantiate the previous European expert-network profile.
overview:
Clermont Partners was founded in 2015 and acquired by Riveron in June 2022. H.I.G. Capital's acquisition announcement describes ESG strategy, investor relations, and transaction communications services for public and private companies. It identifies Chicago as headquarters and Washington, DC as an additional office at that time.

Recent parent-company development: on March 3, 2026, Riveron announced an investment and growth partnership with AI and data advisory firm Cuesta Partners. This concerns Riveron's CFO advisory business; the announcement does not establish a Clermont expert-matching platform.

history.narrative: The acquisition announcement dates Clermont's founding to 2015 and names Elizabeth Saunders and Victoria Sivrais as co-founders. The 2022 transaction added its services to Riveron's ESG and Strategic Communications practice.

timeline.event: Founded by Elizabeth Saunders and Victoria Sivrais, according to the acquisition announcement.
Riveron acquired Clermont Partners in June; the announcement reported a 35-person team.
Parent-company update: Riveron announced its Cuesta Partners investment and growth partnership on March 3.

servicesDetailed.name: ESG Strategy & Communications
servicesDetailed.description: The 2022 acquisition announcement says Clermont advised companies on ESG strategy and stakeholder communications.

servicesDetailed.name: Investor Relations
servicesDetailed.description: The announcement describes building corporate IR programs and supporting investor engagement.

servicesDetailed.name: Transaction Communications
servicesDetailed.description: Transaction communications was identified as a service at the time of the Riveron acquisition.

clientFit.narrative: The acquisition announcement positions Clermont's services for public and private companies seeking ESG and investor communications advice.

caveats: The reviewed acquisition sources describe a corporate advisory consultancy, without substantiating expert-network services.
The staff figure and office locations are dated June 2022; current standalone staffing, pricing, and expert-network capabilities were not verified.
The March 2026 AI and data investment is a Riveron development; it does not substantiate the previous Clermont AI-matching claims.
notableFacts: Riveron acquired Clermont Partners in June 2022.
A March 2026 Riveron investment in Cuesta Partners adds parent-company context to this historical profile.
sourceNotes: H.I.G. Capital acquisition announcement, June 30, 2022 — https://hig.com/news/riveron-an-h-i-g-capital-portfolio-company-acquires-clermont-partners/ — accessed 2026-11-11. Primary source for founding, founders, acquisition, services, client positioning, Chicago headquarters, Washington, DC office, and the company-reported 35 staff at that date. Does not substantiate the former London/European expert-network description, 40K+ experts, per-call pricing, AI features, or FCA/EU MAR compliance claims; those claims and associated badges were removed or made explicit unknowns.

ESG Today acquisition coverage, June 30, 2022 — https://www.esgtoday.com/esg-ir-advisory-clermont-acquired-by-h-i-g-capitals-riveron/ — accessed 2026-11-11. Independent reporting corroborates the 2015 founding, corporate advisory services, Riveron acquisition, and dated team locations.

O'Dwyer's acquisition coverage, July 1, 2022 — https://www.odwyerpr.com/story/public/18143/2022-07-01/riveron-acquires-clermont-partners.html — accessed 2026-11-11. Public article excerpt corroborates Chicago, the acquisition, and a 35-member ESG communications and investor relations firm; the subscriber-only article was not used.

They Got Acquired retrospective, April 15, 2026 — https://theygotacquired.com/services/clermont-partners-acquired-by-riveron-consulting/ — accessed 2026-11-11. Recent coverage concerns the historical 2022 sale and reports the founders' departures in 2023 and 2024. Its 43-employee sale figure differs from the contemporaneous primary announcement's 35; this profile retains the dated primary figure, without treating either as current staffing.

Riveron/Business Wire press release, March 3, 2026, hosted by AP News — https://apnews.com/press-release/business-wire/kohlberg-and-riveron-announce-strategic-investment-in-cuesta-partners-to-expand-into-ai-and-data-advisory-services-dfc38dd27f6042e889ae371301236b1d — accessed 2026-11-11. Company-stated parent-company investment and growth partnership with Cuesta Partners for CFO-focused AI and data advisory; not evidence of Clermont expert matching. Review of developments from 2025-11-11 through 2026-11-11 found no substantiated separate Clermont expert-network launch, funding, office expansion, or AI platform.

Ropes & Gray transaction announcement, March 4, 2026 — https://www.ropesgray.com/en/news-and-events/news/2026/03/kohlberg-backed-riveron-announces-strategic-investment-in-cuesta-partners — accessed 2026-11-11. Riveron's transaction counsel corroborates the Cuesta investment and its March 3 announcement date.
employeeCountSource: H.I.G. Capital acquisition announcement, June 30, 2022; not a current headcount
